title: Quadratic Equations in Graph Products of Groups and the Exponent of Periodicity
summary: In 1977, Makanin established the decidability of equations in free monoids. A key ingredient in his proof is the exponent of periodicity: for a word $w$, it is the largest exponent $e$ such that $w$ contains a nonempty factor of the form $p^e$. Makanin showed the following for a system of equations in free monoids: if the system has a solution with a sufficiently large exponent of periodicity, then it has infinitely many solutions.
